note: Budgets that have to agree across the wire when a conversation command opens or restores an agent. The gateway spends launchMs waiting for a freshly staged runtime to answer at all — that interval is the operating system scanning it on first execution, not protocol work — then startupMs on the rest of the handshake, then up to shutdownGraceMs + killTimeoutMs tearing a failed process down before it can answer. A client that gives up sooner deletes the request and drops the typed answer when it finally arrives, and the caller is told 'command failed' for a failure the gateway described exactly. One table, so the two sides cannot drift: crates/nessa-server/src/composition/agent_budgets.rs and packages/nessa-client/src/application/agent-budgets.ts read these same bytes.

client.note: Added to the gateway's worst case to cover audit writes, the response write, and scheduling. The client budget is a backstop against a gateway that has stopped answering at all, not a second opinion about how long a launch may take.
